payload.title: Bug: mergeRunnerItem's post-merge integrity check (branchContentMismatch, src/runner/merge.mjs…
payload.description:
Bug: mergeRunnerItem's post-merge integrity check (branchContentMismatch, src/runner/merge.mjs ~line 1254) false-positives on a legitimate ADR0020 .fgos/ exclusion.

branchContentMismatch() compares a branch's own introduced paths (base..branch diff) against what its merge commit actually changed, to catch a "git merge -s ours" content-discard. It has no exemption for .fgos/ paths, even though ADR0020 requires every worker branch to exclude .fgos/ diffs entirely (docs/how-to/fix-fgos-write-rejected-merge-block.md, tsk-3v2 precedent: restoring .fgos/ paths to the branch's own frozen versions before committing is the documented, sanctioned recovery for a merge-conflict park).

Confirmed false positive, live, on tsk-gb3 (2026-08-24 ~22:40 local): after manually resolving a merge-conflict park by merging main into fgw/tsk-gb3 and restoring .fgos/ paths to the branch's own pre-merge versions per that same how-to, `fgos approve tsk-gb3 --acknowledge-iron-law` returned {to: "blocked", reason: "verify-fail-post-merge"} with output: integrity check failed: "fgw/tsk-gb3" is an ancestor of HEAD but its own content is not reflected there for: .fgos/approve-post-success-faults.jsonl, .fgos/changelog-nag-history.jsonl, .fgos/entropy-history.jsonl, .fgos/events/*.jsonl (5 files), .fgos/main-checkout-guard-warnings.jsonl.

Verified false positive, not a real content discard: the branch's real feature diff (resolveExecutorEnv export in src/runner/dispatch.mjs, env field validation in src/runner/dispatch/config.mjs) is fully and correctly present on main at the merge commit (8897162a). Only .fgos/ paths are flagged, and those are legitimately absent by ADR0020 design, never discarded content.

Effect: the work item's own status metadata is stuck reporting "blocked" indefinitely (retrying hits the same deterministic check every time) even though the real code landed correctly and safely on main -- a cosmetic/tracking-only symptom, but one that blocks the normal awaiting-approval -> delivered status transition and misleads anyone reading fgos check / fgos list.

Fix direction (not yet designed): branchContentMismatch's introducedPaths/changedByMerge comparison should exclude any path under .fgos/, mirroring resolveFgosOnlyConflict's own isMergeUnionPath-gated .fgos/ exemption a few dozen lines above it in the same file, since ADR0020 already guarantees no worker branch can legitimately reflect main's live .fgos/ content.
